We may only terminate the Area Development Agreement for good cause based on your material default.

The proposed buyer must assume your existing Area Development Agreement for the remainder of your Development Term.

You or the proposed buyer must pay us a $10,000 transfer fee or less if the Event of Transfer is a Qualified Transfer.

We can match any third party offer to buy your franchise rights, assets or controlling interest which is the subject of a proposed Event of Transfer. We have 30 days in which to exercise our right of first refusal. We do not have a right of first refusal when the Event of Transfer is a Qualified Transfer.

Because the Area Development Agreement is a personal service contract, we treat the death of a Primary Owner that results in a change in the ownership of a controlling interest of a franchisee that is a business entity as an Event of Transfer subject to all transfer conditions.

Once you sign the Area Development Agreement, you are subject to the same non-complete covenant during the term of the Area Development Agreement as you are during the term of the Franchise Agreement.
R. Non-competition covenants after the franchise terminates or expires N/A N/A
Same dispute resolution provisions as the Franchise Agreement.

The Franchise Agreement has a forum selection provision which requires that a lawsuit to be filed in the state or federal courts located closest to our headquarters, which at this time are in Garden Grove, California. Certain states have laws that supersede the choice of forum in the Franchise Agreement and require that a lawsuit be brought in the state or federal courts in the franchisee’s home state. See the State Addendum, Exhibit I.

rows.summary: Between 2014 and 2024, Item 17 shifts materially toward franchisor discretion: renewal moved from automatic to qualification-based, the transfer fee doubled from $3,000 to $6,000, post-termination exit fee and customer communication obligations were introduced, forum and law changed from North Carolina to Texas, and the death/disability territory-return consequence was removed.

Be in compliance with franchisee performance expectations, training, financial obligations, and agree to any updates or changes in C12 business model which may have occurred during prior year by signing a Franchise Compliance Administrative Update letter each year. There is no renewal fee.
C12 can terminate only if you default on your obligations and are unwilling to remedy the breach within 30 days. In less time-sensitive instances, C12 may choose to give a 90- day notice.
C12 can terminate only if you default on your obligations and are unwilling to remedy the breach within 30 days.
transfer fee of $3,000 paid

Franchise must be assigned by estate to a C12-approved buyer within six months of your involuntary physical departure from the practice to qualify as a transfer or the Territory simply returns to C12 with compensation.

confidentiality regarding C12 materials

North Carolina law applies.

newEvidence.quote: Your Term runs through December 31st of the year after you sign the Franchise Agreement.
You may, subject to qualifying for renewal, renew the Franchise Agreement for an unlimited number of twelve-month renewal terms.
You must provide us with ninety (90) days’ notice if you choose to not renew the Franchise Agreement.
Upon notice of non-renewal, you must take all reasonable steps to ensure continuity of the Franchised Business or, if we decide to wind it down, the winding down of the Franchised Business.

C12 reserves the right to remedy breaches of this agreement, including defaulting on financial obligations, failure to deliver services/products in conformity to the Franchise Operations Manual parameters, moral turpitude, failure to fulfill franchise territory development potential, negligence in developing the territory, or prolonged poor quality service
by either restructuring the scope of or terminating entirely the Franchise Agreement for a given Territory
